entries.what: The items_by_column_values and items_by_multiple_column_values queries are removed, in API version 2023-10. The notes date the version and not the removal, so diedOn is the first day of that version.

source.quote: Removed the deprecated items_by_column_values and items_by_multiple_column_values objects, replaced them with items_page_by_column_values

lookFor: A GraphQL query naming items_by_column_values or items_by_multiple_column_values
requires: A request with no API-Version header runs at the Current version, and only recent versions are served, so no pin brings these back.
Results come back as a page with a cursor, under items_page_by_column_values.items.

entries.what: The items field on boards and groups queries is removed, in API version 2023-10. The notes date the version and not the removal, so diedOn is the first day of that version.

source.quote: Removed the deprecated items field on boards queries, replaced it with items_page

lookFor: A GraphQL query with items directly under boards { ... } or groups { ... }
requires: A request with no API-Version header runs at the Current version, and only recent versions are served, so no pin brings these back.
items_page returns { cursor, items } and takes a limit, so the read path changes as well as the query.
